# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 51 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 39-40 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_051_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 51

**1** His disciples said to him: "When will the repose of the dead come, and when will the new world arrive?"

**2** He said to them: "What you are looking for has already come, but you do not recognize it."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "Repose of the dead" — the rest promised to the departed; an eschatological expectation
- "New world" — the cosmological renewal
- "Has already come, but you do not recognize it" — the realized eschatology of Thomas; what they seek is present
- "Recognize" — not merely intellectual knowledge but perception/acknowledgment
